extracted.name: Balsamic Brussels Sprouts with Feta Cheese and Walnuts
extracted.description: Balsamic Brussels sprouts are roasted with onion and garlic and mixed with feta cheese, walnuts, and cranberries in this delicious side dish recipe.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).

Combine Brussels sprouts, red onion, and garlic in a bowl; drizzle balsamic vinegar, olive oil, and maple syrup over top and toss to coat. Season with salt and black pepper; transfer to a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven until sprouts are tender and sauce thickened, about 40 minutes.
Transfer Brussels sprouts mixture to a serving bowl. Add walnuts, cranberries, and feta cheese; stir to combine.
